mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.5% over 3 months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days via reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% from 3-month highs, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) combined with high CPI index (CPIAUCSL > 270.0) indicates stagflationary pressure, compressing corporate margins and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and CPIAUCSL > 270.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
